purpose: Decorative Arena interface art only; no Pet, gear, ownership or combat changes

prompts.tag:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for AXO Pet's degen crypto Arena web interface, replacing a crude SVG graffiti tag.
Create ONE isolated hand-painted graffiti wordmark reading exactly "AXO" (A X O), no other letters or text. Front-facing, horizontal, clearly readable at small sizes. Bold energetic wildstyle / chunky street lettering with acid-lime faces, deep violet inner shadows, ivory edge highlights and near-black ink keyline. Rich authentic aerosol grain, uneven spray edges, a few tasteful paint drips, layered marker strokes and worn ink. Premium game brand art with a rebellious playful degen feel. Material pigment and hand-drawn texture, not flat vector clipart, not a font mockup, not chrome 3D.
Composition: complete wordmark centered with comfortable transparent margin on all sides; wide landscape composition around 2:1. Three letters form one cohesive mark, do not overlap enough to impair reading. All drips and overspray remain inside the image. Genuinely transparent background, preserve soft alpha around spray. No wall, no ground, no rectangle, no checkerboard, no product mockup, no watermark, no UI. This is a standalone decorative overlay; do not include a Pet or clothing.
prompts.mascot: Generate one isolated hand-painted axolotl mascot sticker for a game interface. Cute cream-coloured axolotl head with three feathery purple external gills on each side, bright lime-green eyes and a cheeky smile, small charcoal hoodie collar. Distressed ivory die-cut sticker border with a dark outline, violet and acid-lime paint flecks. Rich illustrated paint and ink texture, premium game art and skate-sticker style, no flat vector look. Complete square sticker with transparent margins. No text, no background, no wall, no surface, no checkerboard, no extra items. Genuine transparent background.
prompts.no-rug: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE premium street-art sticker asset for the AXO Pet degen Arena game UI. Exact text, two lines: "NO RUG" / "ZONE". Bold chunky distressed black hand-lettering, perfectly readable and spelled exactly, on a torn ivory paper / die-cut vinyl sticker. Irregular cut edge, lightly scuffed print grain, a little violet marker scribble and acid-lime spray at the edges, subtle folded lower corner, tactile painted finish. Rebellious funny crypto skate culture, not a flat vector rectangle. Straight front view, no extreme perspective or built-in rotation. Complete isolated sticker centered with transparent margin on all sides. Genuinely transparent background; no wall, surface, mockup, checkerboard, watermark, extra text, extra stickers or objects.
prompts.stay-weird: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE hand-painted premium graffiti sticker for AXO Pet's degen Arena wardrobe. Exact text: "STAY WEIRD." in two compact lines STAY / WEIRD. A cohesive die-cut street sticker with worn ivory border, skate zine / degen culture energy. Clearly readable; no other text, no icons or characters. Thick charcoal ink contour, worn ivory die-cut rim, brush/ink texture and tasteful halftone grain. Premium painted game art blended with underground skate sticker culture. Playful diamond-hands reference. Not flat vector, no clip-art aesthetic, no chrome wordmark. Centered square composition, entire sticker visible with generous transparent margin.
